notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it targeting Izzet Boilerworks, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat.
